purpose: Teach: 初対面/待たさ/ヘッドホン/トレイ/興味津々/へっ/はぎ/通り過ぎる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「初対面の方には丁寧に挨拶しなさい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "Greet people politely when you meet them for the first time."
lines.style: Gentle instructive warmth; the quoted rule delivered slowly, with a mother's careful emphasis.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「子供達を長く待たされた」って苦笑いされてたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad gave a funny little smile and said the kids kept him waiting forever.
lines.style: Soft giggle underneath; imitating dad's wry smile with a child's delighted mimicry.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヘッドホンで音楽を楽しんでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's enjoying his music on his headphones right now.
lines.style: Quiet, fond observation; voice lowered a touch, as if not to disturb him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと夕食のトレイを運ぶ手伝いをしたよ
lines.en: Mama, I helped Dad carry the dinner trays!
lines.style: Bright little swell of pride on the helping; quick pace, chin-up finish.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい趣味に興味津々で取り組んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's throwing himself into his new hobby, just brimming with curiosity.
lines.style: Amused warmth quickening slightly; affectionate stress on how absorbed he is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「へっ、まだまだだぞ」って試されたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad went "Heh, you've still got a long way to go!" and tested me.
lines.style: Puffed-up imitation of dad's gruff "heh", then dissolving into a shy giggle.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「萩、つまりはぎの花を観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, "Let's go see the hagi — the bush clover blossoms."
lines.style: Soft, dreamy slowing on the flower's name; a small anticipatory smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「車が通り過ぎるのを待つ」横断歩道の安全を学んだよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad taught me crosswalk safety — you wait for the cars to pass by first!
lines.style: Careful, earnest recitation; slowing on the safety rule, proud of remembering it exactly.
